title: Australian man accused of murdering Thai teenager and putting body in suitcase pleads not guilty
summary_full: Simon Peter Carman appeared in a Pattaya court on Friday charged with killing  Tunchanok Donhomla An Australian man accused of murdering a Thai teenager and putting her body in a suitcase pleaded not guilty on Friday in a hearing in the seaside resort city of Pattaya, a court official said.Simon Peter Carman, 45, was arrested in June after 17-year-old Tunchanok Donhomla was reported missing in Pattaya City, about 150km south-east of Bangkok. A suitcase containing her body was found shortly after. Continue reading...
